response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT t.telescregistry AS telesc, o.weathprofile AS weath, AVG(s.modindex) AS avg_mod, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) AS avg_phase FROM signals s JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile), b AS (SELECT AVG(avg_mod) AS baseline FROM g), k AS (SELECT g.*, b.baseline FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT weath AS weathprofile, AVG(avg_mod) AS avg_modindex, AVG(avg_phase) AS avg_phaseshift, AVG(avg_mod - baseline) AS avg_excess_over_baseline FROM k GROUP BY weath
